name: Verdion Evidence Bounty Acceptance Rubric
description: Standardized evaluation criteria for reviewing evidence bounty submissions (§11.3)

criteria.name: Source Authenticity and Provenance
criteria.description: The evidence must originate from an official, authoritative source (e.g. regulatory agency, court, legislative gazette). A valid URL or document reference with cryptographic digest is required.

criteria.name: Relevance to Exact Research Question
criteria.description: Passage directly addresses the specific legal question or compliance gap stated in the bounty specification.

criteria.name: Jurisdictional Applicability and Effective Date
criteria.description: Source must be active and legally applicable to the target jurisdiction as of the assessment date; superseded or amended statutes without explicit savings provisions are rejected.

criteria.name: Reproducibility and Exact Passage Reference
criteria.description: Submission must provide exact chapter, section, paragraph, or page references capable of independent verification without ambiguity.

criteria.name: Novelty Relative to Existing Evidence
criteria.description: Evidence must not be a duplicate or trivial restatement of materials already accepted into the case's versioned corpus.

criteria.name: Demonstrable Effect on Defined Uncertainty
criteria.description: Submission clearly reduces the target uncertainty score or establishes a dispositive legal rule.

anti_gaming_rules: Identical digests to existing accepted evidence trigger automatic duplicate rejection (FR-045)
Submissions lacking explicit effective-date metadata fail JURISDICTION_DATE check
Review decisions must cite at least two positive rubric criteria and full reviewer address
